headline: Jasvinder Singh Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations (Reg 31(4))
sum: Jasvinder Singh has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Takeover Code, signalling substantial share acquisition or intent in GNA Axles Limited; the substantive shareholding data and acquisition structure require review of the full NSE filing.
detail: Jasvinder Singh has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the NSE. This regulation requires disclosure of acquisition of 25% or more shares, or control, triggering takeover Code obligations. The full disclosure document-filed via NSE's regulatory portal-contains the acquirer's identity, shareholding pattern, acquisition date, consideration and any exemption sought. GNA Axles Limited is an automotive components manufacturer listed on NSE; the transaction structure and any mandatory open-offer exemption require review of the complete filing and company response.
